thread:
sophie: Quick postmortem follow-up: vendor auth + model-registry outage. We need owners, short deadlines, and a recurrence detection rule. Who takes what?

omar: I can own the auth mitigation (sticky tokens + reissue backfill). Plan: spike on staging behind FF, 48h canary, then rollout.

lucy: I'll take the model-registry retry/backstop: durable webhook buffer, DLQ after 5 retries, idempotency keys, and an S3 cold-store. Target prototype in 10 days.

tom: I'll handle vendor comms and SLA ask. Need exact failure windows and sample request IDs to escalate.

sophie: Add acceptance criteria in the tracker: auth canary 5xx <= 0.1% over 48h; webhook deliverability >= 99.9% on 95th-replay; fallback routing <1% error delta.

omar: Spike checklist: 1) staging FF 2) canary at 2% 3) monitor auth_5xx, token_error_rate, webhook_5xx. Kill-switch if auth_5xx > 0.3%. Demo by EOW (+5d).

lucy: For the buffer: aim for at-least-once delivery with dedupe via idempotency key. Cold-read latency risk -> mitigate with local cache + prefetch. PR target: 2026-04-18.

tom: Vendor ask draft: request RCA and ETA for fix, provide our captured timestamps (2026-03-28 01:12-01:28 UTC), ask for SLA credit. I'll post draft here for review.

ops-bot: Created tickets: INC-5342 (omar) auth-sticky-reissue, INC-5343 (lucy) registry-buffer. Weekly owner pings enabled.

sophie: Add operational rules: label as "recurring-pattern" if same vendor outage occurs 3x in 90 days -> escalate to contracts + execs. Auto-assign to oncall after 72h if owner is unavailable.

omar: I'll include a reissue/backfill job and a key-management check with security. @sophie can you help loop in sec for a 48h review?

sophie: On it  I'll ping sec for a fast review window.

lucy: I'll add synthetic replay tests to CI to validate delivery and DLQ rates.

tom: I'll share the vendor comms draft in 1h. Reconvene in 14 days for status. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up sync in 14 days (thread pinned).
